title: Lyme Disease Surveillance Data | Lyme Disease | CDC
content: Lyme Disease Surveillance Data Feb. 11, 2025 Key points Lyme disease cases are reported to CDC by state health departments and the District of Columbia through the National Notifiable Diseases Surveillance System (NNDSS). Explore information on reported Lyme disease cases by year in the United States, including: total number of cases reported, rates, seasonality, and demographic data. Interactive data *Due to the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic, 2019 and 2020 data from some jurisdictions are incomplete. Dashboard data files Note: some formatting errors may appear when opening .csv files in Excel. Import .csv into Excel or open files as .txt to avoid errors.
